ex.en: I want to enroll at graduate school.
ex.zh: 我想就讀研究所。

ex.en: She enrolled in an evening English class.
ex.zh: 她報名了夜間英文班。

enroll.en: to officially join a school, course or group

ex.en: The app encrypts all your messages.
ex.zh: 這個 App 會把你所有的訊息加密。

ex.en: Encrypted files cannot be read without a password.
ex.zh: 加密的檔案沒有密碼就無法讀取。

encrypt.en: to change information into a secret code so others cannot read it

ex.en: Videos usually get more engagement than photos.
ex.zh: 影片通常比照片獲得更多互動。

ex.en: We're trying to increase customer engagement.
ex.zh: 我們正努力提高顧客參與度。

engagement.en: the amount that people react to or take part in something online

ex.en: I congratulate you on your engagement.
ex.zh: 恭喜你訂婚了。

ex.en: He announced his engagement to her.
ex.zh: 他宣布和她訂婚。

ex.en: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."
ex.zh: 「你們不是結婚了嗎？」「喔，我們分手了，婚約也取消了。」

engagement.en: an agreement to marry, or the time before the wedding

ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
ex.zh: 工程師告訴我們如何使用機器。

ex.en: I cannot calculate this. I am not an engineer.
ex.zh: 我算不出來，我不是工程師。

ex.en: The committee consists of scientists and engineers.
ex.zh: 委員會由科學家和工程師組成。

engineer.en: a person who designs, builds or repairs machines, roads or systems

ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
ex.zh: 我們應該對人類使用基因工程嗎？

ex.en: Genetic engineering can make crops resistant to disease.
ex.zh: 基因工程可以讓作物抵抗疾病。

engineer.en: changing the genes of a living thing by scientific methods

ex.en: It is an endangered species.
ex.zh: 這是一種瀕臨絕種的物種。

ex.en: There are many endangered species.
ex.zh: 有許多瀕危物種。

ex.en: Murdering elephants, tigers and other endangered species is not just cruel; it's also illegal.
ex.zh: 殺害大象、老虎等瀕危物種不只殘忍，也是違法的。

ex.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
ex.zh: 問題是太陽能太貴了。

ex.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 核子反應爐會產生大量的熱能。

energy.en: power such as electricity or oil that is used to make things work

ex.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.
ex.zh: 我在這項計劃上投入了所有精力。

ex.en: All his energies were devoted to the experiment.
ex.zh: 他把全部精力都投入了實驗。

ex.en: If you concentrate all your energies on the study of English, you will master the language.
ex.zh: 如果你把全部精力都放在學英文上，你就能精通這門語言。

energy.en: the strength to be active without getting tired

ex.en: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡力不污染環境。

ex.en: They have no impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 它們對環境沒有任何影響。

ex.en: Eating meat is bad for the environment.
ex.zh: 吃肉對環境不利。

environment.en: the air, water and land where people, animals and plants live

ex.en: They live in a good environment.
ex.zh: 他們生活的環境很好。

ex.en: I work best in a quiet environment.
ex.zh: 我在安靜的環境中工作效率最好。

environment.en: the conditions in which you live or work

ex.en: She sent me the enclosed check.
ex.zh: 她把隨信附上的支票寄給了我。

ex.en: Please find enclosed a copy of the invoice.
ex.zh: 隨信附上發票副本一份，請查收。

ex.en: I have enclosed my résumé for your review.
ex.zh: 隨函附上我的履歷，敬請參閱。

enclose.en: to put something inside an envelope with a letter

ex.en: The garden is enclosed by a high wall.
ex.zh: 花園被一道高牆圍住。

ex.en: A fence encloses the parking area.
ex.zh: 停車區四周用圍籬圍起來。

enclose.en: to surround something on all sides

ex.en: George is very enthusiastic about his new job.
ex.zh: 喬治對自己的新工作充滿熱情。

ex.en: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是非常狂熱的足球迷。

ex.en: The audience gave an enthusiastic response.
ex.zh: 觀眾反應非常熱烈。

ex.en: Everyone is an entrepreneur.
ex.zh: 人人都是創業家。

ex.en: She is a young entrepreneur who started her own company.
ex.zh: 她是自己開公司的年輕創業家。

ex.en: Many entrepreneurs fail before they succeed.
ex.zh: 很多創業家在成功之前都失敗過。

entrepreneur.en: a person who starts a business and takes risks to make money

ex.en: I had an enjoyable two weeks in London.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦度過了愉快的兩個星期。

ex.en: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
ex.zh: 這張照片讓我想起童年的快樂時光。

ex.en: Thank you for a very enjoyable evening.
ex.zh: 謝謝你讓我度過一個非常愉快的晚上。

ex.en: He's not as energetic as he used to be.
ex.zh: 他不像從前那樣精力充沛了。

ex.en: The young man is both capable and energetic, needless to say.
ex.zh: 這個年輕人既能幹又積極，這點不用說。

ex.en: I feel more energetic now.
ex.zh: 我現在覺得比較有精神了。

energetic.en: having or showing a lot of energy

environmentally.zh: 在環境方面（environmentally friendly：環保的）

ex.en: Solar power is environmentally friendly.
ex.zh: 太陽能很環保。

ex.en: This product is environmentally friendly.
ex.zh: 這項產品很環保。

ex.en: Tom is environmentally conscious.
ex.zh: 湯姆很有環保意識。

environmentally.en: in a way that relates to nature and its protection

ex.en: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
ex.zh: 他熱忱地投入這份光榮的事業。

ex.en: The audience applauded enthusiastically.
ex.zh: 觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

ex.en: She talked enthusiastically about her new job.
ex.zh: 她興致勃勃地談起她的新工作。

enthusiastically.en: in a way that shows great interest and excitement

ex.en: Tom doesn't share Mary's enthusiasm.
ex.zh: 湯姆不像瑪麗那麼熱衷。

ex.en: Enthusiasm is contagious.
ex.zh: 熱情是會傳染的。

ex.en: She showed great enthusiasm for the new project.
ex.zh: 她對新專案展現極大的熱忱。

enthusiasm.en: a strong feeling of interest and excitement

ex.en: Enrollment for the course opens next week.
ex.zh: 這門課下週開放報名。

ex.en: The school's enrollment has increased by 10%.
ex.zh: 學校的學生人數增加了 10%。

enrollment.en: the act of joining a school or course, or the number of people who join

ex.en: The subsidiary operates as a separate legal entity.
ex.zh: 這家子公司是獨立的法人實體。

ex.en: The two companies merged into a single entity.
ex.zh: 兩家公司合併成一個實體。

entity.en: something that exists separately, such as a company or organization

ex.en: The police are enforcing the new speed limits.
ex.zh: 警方正在執行新的速限規定。

ex.en: The company strictly enforces its safety rules.
ex.zh: 公司嚴格執行安全規定。

enforce.en: to make sure that people obey a law or rule

ex.en: The board endorsed the new plan.
ex.zh: 董事會支持這項新計畫。

ex.en: Many experts have endorsed this approach.
ex.zh: 許多專家都贊同這個做法。

endorse.en: to say publicly that you support a person or plan

ex.en: The famous athlete endorses a sports drink brand.
ex.zh: 那位知名運動員代言一個運動飲料品牌。

ex.en: Celebrities are often paid millions to endorse products.
ex.zh: 名人代言產品常可拿到數百萬酬勞。

endorse.en: to say in advertisements that you like a product, usually for payment

ex.en: Please endorse the check on the back.
ex.zh: 請在支票背面背書。

ex.en: You must endorse the cheque before depositing it.
ex.zh: 存入支票前必須先背書。

endorse.en: to sign the back of a check so it can be paid

ex.en: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
ex.zh: 政府將採取強制措施來解決這個問題。

ex.en: Law enforcement officers arrived quickly.
ex.zh: 執法人員很快就到了。

ex.en: Stricter enforcement of the rules is needed.
ex.zh: 規定需要更嚴格地執行。

enforcement.en: the act of making people obey a law or rule

ex.en: Can she endure a long trip?
ex.zh: 她受得了長途旅行嗎？

ex.en: I cannot endure being disturbed in my work.
ex.zh: 我無法忍受工作時被打擾。

ex.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
ex.zh: 這些移民承受了身心上的痛苦。

endure.en: to suffer something painful or difficult without giving up

ex.en: Their friendship has endured for over 30 years.
ex.zh: 他們的友誼已維持了三十多年。

ex.en: Good design will always endure.
ex.zh: 好的設計永遠經得起時間考驗。

endure.en: to continue to exist for a long time

ex.en: The government enacted a new privacy law.
ex.zh: 政府制定了新的隱私法。

ex.en: The law was enacted in 2020.
ex.zh: 這項法律於 2020 年頒布。

enact.en: to make a proposal into an official law

ex.en: The university has a large endowment.
ex.zh: 這所大學擁有龐大的捐贈基金。

ex.en: Her family made a generous endowment to the hospital.
ex.zh: 她的家人捐了一大筆錢給醫院。

endowment.en: a large amount of money given to an organization to support it

ex.en: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
ex.zh: 他在百科全書裡查了這個詞。

ex.en: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia.
ex.zh: 維基百科是免費的線上百科全書。

encyclopedia.en: a book or website with facts about many subjects

ex.en: What exactly does the job entail?
ex.zh: 這份工作具體包含哪些內容？

ex.en: The project will entail a lot of overtime.
ex.zh: 這個專案會需要大量加班。

entail.en: to involve something as a necessary part or result

ex.en: The enlargement of the airport will take two years.
ex.zh: 機場擴建工程需要兩年。

ex.en: The enlargement of the parking lot was finally approved.
ex.zh: 停車場的擴建案終於核准了。

enlargement.en: the act of making something bigger

ex.en: I ordered an enlargement of this photo.
ex.zh: 我訂了一張這張照片的放大版。

ex.en: Can you make an enlargement of the map?
ex.zh: 你可以把這張地圖放大印一份嗎？

enlargement.en: a photograph that has been printed bigger

ex.en: The job encompasses a wide range of responsibilities.
ex.zh: 這份工作涵蓋範圍廣泛的職責。

ex.en: The new plan encompasses all of our Asian markets.
ex.zh: 新計畫涵蓋我們所有的亞洲市場。

encompass.en: to include a large number or range of things

ex.en: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.
ex.zh: 他試圖擴大自己的勢力範圍。

ex.en: Can you enlarge this photo for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這張照片放大嗎？

ex.en: The store was enlarged last year.
ex.zh: 這家店去年擴建了。

ex.en: New entrants to the market face strong competition.
ex.zh: 新進入市場的業者面臨激烈競爭。

ex.en: Each entrant must submit a form before Friday.
ex.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在星期五前交表格。

entrant.en: a person or company that enters a competition or market

ex.en: She has a strong entrepreneurial spirit.
ex.zh: 她有很強的創業精神。

ex.en: Taiwan has a lively entrepreneurial culture.
ex.zh: 台灣有很活躍的創業文化。

entrepreneurial.en: relating to starting new businesses and taking risks

ex.en: You should enrich your mind when young.
ex.zh: 你應該趁年輕充實自己。

ex.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
ex.zh: 與她的相遇豐富了他的內心世界。

ex.en: Traveling abroad can enrich your life.
ex.zh: 出國旅行可以豐富你的人生。

enrich.en: to make something better in quality or value

ex.en: The deal enriched a few top executives.
ex.zh: 這筆交易讓少數高階主管發了財。

ex.en: Oil has enriched the country.
ex.zh: 石油讓這個國家變得富有。

ex.en: The new update includes several security enhancements.
ex.zh: 這次更新包含幾項安全性強化。

ex.en: We are focusing on the enhancement of customer service.
ex.zh: 我們正致力於提升客戶服務。

enhancement.en: a change that makes something better

enforceable.zh: （法律、合約）可強制執行的、可實施的

ex.en: Is a verbal agreement legally enforceable?
ex.zh: 口頭協議在法律上能強制執行嗎？

ex.en: The new rules must be clear and enforceable.
ex.zh: 新規定必須清楚且可執行。

enforceable.en: able to be made to happen by law

ex.en: The universe is endless.
ex.zh: 宇宙無窮無盡。

ex.en: It was a fabulous show which brought us an endless delight.
ex.zh: 那是一場精彩的表演，帶給我們無窮的樂趣。

ex.en: I'm tired of these endless meetings.
ex.zh: 我受夠了這些開不完的會。

endless.en: having no end, or seeming to last forever

ex.en: The report is due at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 報告月底要交。

ex.en: Turn left at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 在這條街的盡頭左轉。

end.en: the last part of something, or the point where it stops

ex.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
ex.zh: 冷戰隨著蘇聯解體而結束。

ex.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 直到會議結束，都沒有人注意到她不在。

ex.en: The novel ends with the heroine's death.
ex.zh: 這部小說以女主角的死作結。

end.en: to stop, or to make something stop

end.zh: put an end to：終止、結束

ex.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
ex.zh: 你必須停止這種愚蠢的行為。

ex.en: Diplomatic dialogue helped put an end to the conflict.
ex.zh: 外交對話有助於結束這場衝突。

ex.en: In the end, we chose the cheaper plan.
ex.zh: 最後，我們選了比較便宜的方案。

ex.en: It all worked out in the end.
ex.zh: 最後一切都很順利。

end.en: after a long time or after many events

ex.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
ex.zh: 幸好他有足夠的錢付帳。

ex.en: If I had enough money, I could go abroad.
ex.zh: 如果我有足夠的錢，就能出國了。

enough.en: as much as you need or want

ex.en: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你年紀還不夠大，不能考駕照。

ex.en: This book is easy enough for them to read.
ex.zh: 這本書夠簡單，他們讀得懂。

ex.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
ex.zh: 這把梯子夠堅固，撐得住我的體重嗎？

enough.en: to the amount or degree that is needed

ex.en: "Would you like any more?" "No, I've had enough."
ex.zh: 「還要再來一點嗎？」「不用了，我吃飽了。」

ex.en: Have you had enough to eat?
ex.zh: 你吃飽了嗎？

enough.en: the amount that you need or want

ex.en: He enjoys watching baseball games on TV.
ex.zh: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。

ex.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.
ex.zh: 今晚和你聊天很愉快。

ex.en: Tom and Mary look like they're enjoying the party.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪莉看起來很享受這場派對。

ex.en: Did you enjoy yourself at the party last night?
ex.zh: 你昨晚在派對上玩得開心嗎？

ex.en: We really enjoyed ourselves on the trip.
ex.zh: 我們這趟旅行玩得很開心。

ex.en: Employees enjoy flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 員工享有彈性工時。

ex.en: The city enjoys a mild climate all year.
ex.zh: 這座城市全年氣候溫和。

enjoy.en: to have a good thing as part of your life

ex.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
ex.zh: 進教室時請脫帽。

ex.en: I entered the room and shook hands with him.
ex.zh: 我走進房間跟他握手。

ex.en: No student is allowed to enter the room.
ex.zh: 學生不准進入這個房間。

enter.en: to go or come into a place

ex.en: One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.
ex.zh: 有一百五十人參加了馬拉松比賽。

ex.en: She entered a singing contest last year.
ex.zh: 她去年參加了歌唱比賽。

enter.en: to take part in a race or competition

ex.en: Please enter your password.
ex.zh: 請輸入密碼。

ex.en: Enter your email address below.
ex.zh: 請在下方輸入你的電子郵件地址。

enter.en: to put information into a computer

ex.en: Tom encouraged Mary to learn how to speak French.
ex.zh: 湯姆鼓勵瑪麗學著說法語。

ex.en: When I'm sad, my friends encourage me.
ex.zh: 我傷心的時候，我的朋友會鼓勵我。

ex.en: My father encouraged me to study the piano.
ex.zh: 我爸爸鼓勵我學鋼琴。

encourage.en: to give someone confidence or hope to do something

ex.en: Low prices encourage people to buy more.
ex.zh: 低價會促使人們買更多。

ex.en: The new policy aims to encourage investment.
ex.zh: 新政策旨在促進投資。

encourage.en: to make something more likely to happen

ex.en: I will ensure that your salary increases after one year.
ex.zh: 我保證你一年後會加薪。

ex.en: I want to ensure my phone has good customer support.
ex.zh: 我想確保我的手機有良好的客服支援。

ex.en: Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
ex.zh: 父母常常犧牲自己，確保孩子受到良好教育。

ensure.en: to make certain that something happens

ex.en: I've spent an entire hour waiting for my friend.
ex.zh: 我等朋友等了整整一個小時。

ex.en: We spent the entire day on the beach.
ex.zh: 我們在海灘待了一整天。

ex.en: Tom was the only boy in the entire class.
ex.zh: 湯姆是全班唯一的男生。

ex.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
ex.zh: 我父親從事對外貿易多年。

ex.en: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
ex.zh: 他熱情地投身於這份光榮的事業。

ex.en: Students are encouraged to engage in class discussions.
ex.zh: 老師鼓勵學生參與課堂討論。

engage.en: to take part in an activity

ex.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
ex.zh: 這個 App 每天吸引超過一萬名使用者使用它的功能。

ex.en: A good speaker knows how to engage the audience.
ex.zh: 好的講者懂得如何吸引聽眾。

engage.en: to get someone's interest, or to deal actively with something

ex.en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
ex.zh: 我兒子和他的祕書訂婚了。

ex.en: She is engaged to a rich man.
ex.zh: 她和一個有錢人訂婚了。

engage.en: to have promised to marry someone

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他薪水很高，所以能過得很舒適。

ex.en: Modern travel enables us to go around the world in a few days.
ex.zh: 現代交通讓我們幾天內就能環遊世界。

ex.en: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
ex.zh: 咖啡讓我在無聊的音樂會中保持清醒。

enable.en: to make it possible for someone to do something

ex.en: Please enable cookies in your browser.
ex.zh: 請在瀏覽器中啟用 Cookie。

ex.en: You can enable notifications in the settings.
ex.zh: 你可以在設定中開啟通知。

enable.en: to turn on a feature so that it can be used

ex.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
ex.zh: 工廠廢棄物造成了嚴重的環境汙染。

ex.en: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
ex.zh: 發展經濟和保護環境，哪個比較重要？

ex.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
ex.zh: 人類適應環境變化的能力很強。

environmental.en: relating to the air, water and land around us

ex.en: My opinion is entirely different from yours.
ex.zh: 我的意見和你的完全不同。

ex.en: Compact discs have entirely taken the place of phonograph records.
ex.zh: CD 已經完全取代了黑膠唱片。

ex.en: I'm not entirely sure about that.
ex.zh: 這點我不是完全確定。

ex.en: Tom got in the car and started the engine.
ex.zh: 湯姆上了車，發動引擎。

ex.en: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
ex.zh: 引擎別熄火，我馬上回來。

engine.en: a machine that uses fuel to produce power and movement

ex.en: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
ex.zh: 一個網頁超過九成的訪問量來自搜尋引擎。

ex.en: Which search engine do you usually use?
ex.zh: 你通常用哪個搜尋引擎？

engine.en: a website that helps you find information on the Internet

ex.en: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
ex.zh: 編字典需要花費大量時間。

ex.en: He has enormous potential.
ex.zh: 他有很大的潛力。

ex.en: That plane is enormous!
ex.zh: 那架飛機好大！

ex.en: She doesn't have any enemies at all.
ex.zh: 她一個敵人也沒有。

ex.en: Our biggest enemies may not be other people, but ourselves.
ex.zh: 我們最大的敵人可能不是別人，而是自己。

ex.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
ex.zh: 我們必須團結起來才能打敗敵人。

enemy.en: a person or army that is against you and wants to harm you

ex.en: We are looking for ways to enhance customer satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我們正在尋找提升顧客滿意度的方法。

ex.en: Good lighting can enhance the look of a room.
ex.zh: 好的照明能讓房間看起來更出色。

ex.en: The update enhances the app's security.
ex.zh: 這次更新加強了 App 的安全性。

enhance.en: to make something better or stronger

ex.en: He encountered difficulties in his work.
ex.zh: 他在工作上遇到了困難。

ex.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
ex.zh: 我們在探險途中遇到了很多困難。

ex.en: Today, many problems were encountered.
ex.zh: 今天遇到了很多問題。

encounter.en: to meet something difficult or someone by chance

ex.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
ex.zh: 與她的相遇豐富了他的內心世界。

ex.en: I had a strange encounter on the train today.
ex.zh: 我今天在火車上有一段奇妙的相遇。

encounter.en: a meeting that you did not plan, or a difficult experience

ex.en: Korean entertainment culture is popular worldwide.
ex.zh: 韓國的娛樂文化在全世界都很受歡迎。

ex.en: Australians excel at sports and entertainment.
ex.zh: 澳洲人擅長運動和娛樂。

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment every evening.
ex.zh: 飯店每晚都有現場表演。

entertainment.en: things such as films, music and shows that people enjoy

ex.en: Small and medium-sized enterprises are vital to the economy.
ex.zh: 中小企業對經濟非常重要。

ex.en: She works for a state-owned enterprise.
ex.zh: 她在一家國營企業工作。

ex.en: The job requires energy and enterprise.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要活力和進取心。

ex.en: She showed great enterprise in starting her own business.
ex.zh: 她自行創業，展現了很強的進取心。

enterprise.en: the ability to think of new ideas and try them

entitle.zh: 使有權利、使有資格（be entitled to）

ex.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.
ex.zh: 他有權獲得這份獎勵。

ex.en: I know I'm right, but you're entitled to your opinion.
ex.zh: 我知道我是對的，不過你有權保有自己的看法。

ex.en: Employees are entitled to fourteen days of paid leave.
ex.zh: 員工享有十四天的有薪假。

entitle.en: to give someone the right to have or do something

ex.en: She wrote a book entitled "My Life in Tokyo."
ex.zh: 她寫了一本名為《我在東京的生活》的書。

ex.en: The report is entitled "Future Trends in Retail."
ex.zh: 這份報告的標題是《零售業的未來趨勢》。

entitle.en: to give a book or work a title

ex.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
ex.zh: 我忘了在信封上貼郵票。

ex.en: Xiaoding's father's name is written down on the envelope.
ex.zh: 信封上寫著小丁爸爸的名字。

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封交給瑪麗。

envelope.en: a paper cover in which you put a letter

ex.en: The data is encoded before it is sent.
ex.zh: 資料在傳送前會先編碼。

ex.en: Messages are encoded so that hackers can't read them.
ex.zh: 訊息經過加密編碼，駭客無法讀取。

ex.en: The video was encoded in a high-quality format.
ex.zh: 這部影片以高畫質格式編碼。

encode.en: to change information into a code

ex.en: The project was enormously successful.
ex.zh: 這個專案極為成功。

ex.en: Prices vary enormously from store to store.
ex.zh: 各家店的價格差異非常大。

ex.en: I enjoyed the trip enormously.
ex.zh: 我非常享受這趟旅行。

ex.en: Enzymes help the body digest food.
ex.zh: 酵素幫助身體消化食物。

ex.en: This laundry detergent contains enzymes that remove stains.
ex.zh: 這款洗衣精含有能去除汙漬的酵素。

enzyme.en: a natural substance in living things that helps chemical changes happen

endeavor.zh: 努力；（需要努力的）事業、嘗試

ex.en: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.
ex.zh: 自信是任何偉大事業的首要條件。

ex.en: We wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.
ex.zh: 祝你所有的努力都順利成功。

endeavor.en: a serious attempt or activity that needs effort

ex.en: He endeavored to make his wife happy, but in vain.
ex.zh: 他努力想讓妻子開心，卻徒勞無功。

ex.en: We endeavor to answer all customer inquiries within 24 hours.
ex.zh: 我們盡力在二十四小時內回覆所有客戶詢問。

endeavor.en: to try very hard to do something

ex.en: We stopped for lunch en route to the airport.
ex.zh: 我們在前往機場的途中停下來吃午餐。

ex.en: The package is en route and should arrive tomorrow.
ex.zh: 包裹正在運送途中，明天應該會到。

en route.en: on the way to a place

ex.en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
ex.zh: 我的兒子和他的秘書訂婚了。

ex.en: She is engaged to a rich man.
ex.zh: 她和一個有錢人訂了婚。

ex.en: He got engaged to my cousin.
ex.zh: 他和我的堂姊妹訂婚了。

ex.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
ex.zh: 我父親從事外貿多年。

ex.en: They are engaged in cancer research.
ex.zh: 他們從事癌症研究工作。

ex.en: All entrees come with a salad.
ex.zh: 所有主菜都附沙拉。

ex.en: I'll have the fish as my entree.
ex.zh: 我主菜要點魚。

entree.en: the main dish of a meal

ex.en: Enthusiasts of Japanese culture may enjoy the article "Ergativity and Bare Nouns in Early Old Japanese."
ex.zh: 日本文化愛好者可能會喜歡〈早期古日語的作格性與光桿名詞〉這篇文章。

ex.en: He's a car enthusiast who spends every weekend in his garage.
ex.zh: 他是汽車迷，每個週末都待在車庫裡。

enthusiast.en: a person who is very interested in a certain activity or subject

ex.en: The documentary enlightened viewers about the dangers of smoking.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片讓觀眾認識了吸菸的危害。

ex.en: Can you enlighten me on how this machine works?
ex.zh: 你能不能教我一下這台機器是怎麼運作的？

enlighten.en: to give someone knowledge or understanding

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread enticed us into the bakery.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味把我們引進了麵包店。

ex.en: The store enticed customers with big discounts.
ex.zh: 那家店用大幅折扣來吸引顧客。

entice.en: to attract someone to do something by offering something pleasant

ex.en: Your success excites my envy.
ex.zh: 你的成功使我感到嫉妒。

ex.en: She looked at his new house with envy.
ex.zh: 她以羨慕的眼神看著他的新房子。

envy.en: the unhappy feeling of wanting what someone else has

ex.en: They all envied my new car.
ex.zh: 他們都羨慕我的新車。

ex.en: I have to say I envy you guys.
ex.zh: 我不得不說我羨慕你們。

ex.en: I envy you your luck.
ex.zh: 我嫉妒你的幸運。

envy.en: to wish you had what someone else has

encouraging.zh: 有激勵作用的、令人鼓舞的

ex.en: We have some encouraging news.
ex.zh: 我們有一些令人鼓舞的訊息。

ex.en: Those are encouraging signs.
ex.zh: 那些都是好跡象。

ex.en: The teacher gave him some encouraging words.
ex.zh: 老師對他說了一些鼓勵的話。

ex.en: The forest in the fall is splendidly colorful, a thoroughly enchanting sight.
ex.zh: 秋天的森林五彩斑斕，景色十分迷人。

ex.en: The beauty of the island enchanted every visitor.
ex.zh: 小島的美景讓每位遊客都為之著迷。

ex.en: The storyteller enchanted the children with tales of dragons.
ex.zh: 說書人用龍的故事迷住了孩子們。

enchant.en: to attract and delight someone very strongly

ex.en: John is envious of your new car.
ex.zh: 約翰很忌妒你有新車。

ex.en: She was envious of her cousin's success.
ex.zh: 她羨慕她表哥的成功。

ex.en: She is envious of my good fortune.
ex.zh: 她嫉妒我的好運。

envious.en: feeling unhappy because you want what someone else has

ex.en: Running a marathon requires great physical endurance.
ex.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很好的體力和耐力。

ex.en: Caring for a sick parent tested her patience and endurance.
ex.zh: 照顧生病的父母考驗著她的耐心與毅力。

endurance.en: the ability to keep going despite pain or hard conditions

ex.en: An argument ensued when no one wanted to pay the bill.
ex.zh: 沒人想付帳，接著就吵了起來。

ex.en: After the announcement, a long silence ensued.
ex.zh: 宣布之後，接著是一陣漫長的沉默。

ensue.en: to happen after something else, often as a result

ex.en: The athlete earns millions from endorsements.
ex.zh: 那位運動員靠代言賺了數百萬。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can boost sales.
ex.zh: 名人代言可以提升銷量。

endorsement.en: a famous person's public support of a product, usually for payment

ex.en: A translation is not an endorsement.
ex.zh: 翻譯不代表認同。

ex.en: The plan received the endorsement of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得董事會的支持。

endorsement.en: a public statement of support or approval

ex.en: They entertained us at dinner last night.
ex.zh: 他們昨晚請我們吃晚餐。

ex.en: We often entertain clients at this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們常在這家餐廳招待客戶。

entertain.en: to give food and drink to guests

ex.en: He entertained us with jokes all evening.
ex.zh: 他整晚講笑話逗我們開心。

ex.en: The clown entertained the children.
ex.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們很開心。

entertain.en: to keep people interested and amused

ex.en: Please see the enclosure for the full price list.
ex.zh: 完整價目表請參閱隨函附件。

ex.en: The enclosure was missing from the mailed package.
ex.zh: 寄出的郵件裡漏了附件。

enclosure.en: a document sent in the same envelope as a letter

ex.en: The company is hiring for an entry-level position.
ex.zh: 公司正在招募初階職位人員。

ex.en: This entry-level role includes on-the-job training.
ex.zh: 這個初階職位提供在職訓練。

entry level.en: suitable for a person starting in a job or field

ex.en: The handbook lists each worker’s annual leave entitlement.
ex.zh: 員工手冊列出每位員工應享有的年假天數。

ex.en: Before approving the claim, HR checked her entitlement to relocation support.
ex.zh: 核准申請前，人資確認了她是否符合搬遷補助資格。

entitlement.en: the right to have or receive something

ex.en: Encryption protects customer data during transfer.
ex.zh: 加密可在傳輸過程中保護客戶資料。

ex.en: The app uses encryption to secure each message.
ex.zh: 這款 App 使用加密技術保護每則訊息。

encryption.en: the process of changing information into a secret code

ex.en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
ex.zh: 請在建築的入口處等我。

ex.en: Some people were hanging around at the entrance.
ex.zh: 有些人在入口處停留。

ex.en: Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
ex.zh: 因為門口鎖住了，我們進不了屋子。

entrance.en: a door or gate where you go into a place

ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
ex.zh: 我聽說你通過了入學考試。恭喜你了！

ex.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.
ex.zh: 他忙著準備入學考試。

entrance.en: the act of joining a school or college

ex.en: Entry is strictly for staff only.
ex.zh: 僅限工作人員進入。

ex.en: Disregarding the "No Entry" sign, she pushed open the door and walked inside.
ex.zh: 她不理會「禁止進入」的牌子，推開門走了進去。

entry.en: the act of coming or going into a place

ex.en: This dictionary has about 40,000 entries.
ex.zh: 這本字典大約有四萬個詞條。

ex.en: I made an entry in my diary every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上都會寫一篇日記。

entry.en: one item in a dictionary or in a list of records

ex.en: She sent me the enclosed check.
ex.zh: 她把隨信附上的支票寄給了我。

ex.en: Please find the enclosed contract.
ex.zh: 隨函附上合約，請查收。

enclosed.en: sent inside the same envelope or package

ex.en: She studied civil engineering at a university in Tainan.
ex.zh: 她在台南的一所大學主修土木工程。

ex.en: The bridge is an impressive piece of engineering.
ex.zh: 這座橋是一項令人讚嘆的工程。

ex.en: He works in the engineering department of a software company.
ex.zh: 他在一家軟體公司的工程部門工作。

ex.en: I made an enquiry about the price of the tickets.
ex.zh: 我詢問了票價。

ex.en: The shop answers customer enquiries by phone and email.
ex.zh: 這家店透過電話和電子郵件回覆顧客的詢問。

ex.en: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
ex.zh: 警方對這起意外展開調查。

ex.en: A public enquiry was held after the fire.
ex.zh: 火災後舉行了公開調查。

ex.en: Every employee is entitled to ten days of paid leave.
ex.zh: 每位員工都有權享有十天的有薪假。

ex.en: You are entitled to a refund if the product is broken.
ex.zh: 如果商品壞了，你有權要求退款。

ex.en: She read a book entitled The Little Prince.
ex.zh: 她讀了一本名為《小王子》的書。

ex.en: He wrote an essay entitled My Hometown.
ex.zh: 他寫了一篇題為〈我的家鄉〉的作文。

ex.en: We envisage a future where everyone can work from home.
ex.zh: 我們設想未來每個人都能在家工作。

ex.en: I can't envisage myself living in a big city.
ex.zh: 我無法想像自己住在大城市。

ex.en: Her parents' encouragement helped her keep practicing the piano.
ex.zh: 父母的鼓勵讓她持續練習鋼琴。

ex.en: A few words of encouragement can mean a lot to a nervous student.
ex.zh: 幾句鼓勵的話對緊張的學生來說意義重大。

ex.en: I called the hotel to enquire about room prices.
ex.zh: 我打電話給飯店詢問房價。

ex.en: You can enquire at the front desk if you need help.
ex.zh: 如果需要協助，可以到櫃檯詢問。

ex.en: I can envision a future with clean energy.
ex.zh: 我可以想像一個使用潔淨能源的未來。

ex.en: She envisioned herself running her own shop.
ex.zh: 她想像自己經營一家自己的店。

ex.en: It is hard to envision such a big change.
ex.zh: 很難想像這麼大的改變。

ex.en: England is one of the countries in the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: 英格蘭是英國的組成國之一。

ex.en: London is the largest city in England.
ex.zh: 倫敦是英格蘭最大的城市。

ex.en: We spent our holiday in the south of England.
ex.zh: 我們在英格蘭南部度過了假期。

ex.en: She speaks English and Chinese at work every day.
ex.zh: 她每天在工作中說英語和中文。

ex.en: My English has improved since I started reading novels.
ex.zh: 自從開始讀小說後，我的英文進步了。

ex.en: He had an English breakfast with eggs and toast.
ex.zh: 他吃了一份有蛋和吐司的英式早餐。

ex.en: Our English teacher gives us a short quiz every Friday.
ex.zh: 我們的英文老師每週五都會給一個小考。

ex.en: I didn't like the ending of the movie.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡這部電影的結局。

ex.en: The story has a happy ending.
ex.zh: 這個故事有個圓滿的結局。

ex.en: The book's ending surprised everyone in our club.
ex.zh: 這本書的結尾讓讀書會裡的每個人都很意外。

ex.en: She plays the violin in a string ensemble.
ex.zh: 她在一個弦樂合奏團裡拉小提琴。

ex.en: The school's jazz ensemble performed at the winter concert.
ex.zh: 學校的爵士樂團在冬季音樂會上演出。

ex.en: She wore a stylish ensemble of a gray jacket and matching skirt.
ex.zh: 她穿著灰色外套搭配同款裙子的時尚套裝。

ex.en: He bought a whole new ensemble for the interview.
ex.zh: 他為了面試買了一整套新衣服。

ex.en: He decided to enlist in the army after high school.
ex.zh: 他高中畢業後決定從軍。

ex.en: Many young men enlisted when the war began.
ex.zh: 戰爭爆發時，許多年輕人入伍了。

ex.en: She enlisted her friends to help her move.
ex.zh: 她請朋友幫忙搬家。

ex.en: The charity hopes to enlist more volunteers this summer.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體希望今年夏天招募到更多志工。

ex.en: The Englishman ordered a cup of tea.
ex.zh: 那位英國男子點了一杯茶。

ex.en: An Englishman and a Frenchman were sitting next to me on the train.
ex.zh: 火車上，一位英國人和一位法國人坐在我旁邊。

ex.en: An environmentalist spoke at the school about recycling.
ex.zh: 一位環保人士到學校演講，談資源回收。

ex.en: Environmentalists are worried about the loss of forests.
ex.zh: 環保人士擔心森林的消失。

ex.en: She reads novels purely for enjoyment.
ex.zh: 她讀小說純粹是為了享受閱讀的樂趣。

ex.en: The loud noise spoiled our enjoyment of the movie.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的聲音破壞了我們看電影的興致。

ex.en: He found great enjoyment in teaching his daughter to cook.
ex.zh: 他從教女兒煮菜中得到很大的樂趣。

ex.en: The movie was funny and very entertaining.
ex.zh: 這部電影既搞笑又很好看。

ex.en: He is an entertaining speaker who always makes people laugh.
ex.zh: 他是個風趣的演講者，總是讓大家笑開懷。

ex.en: The phone has an enhanced camera for taking night photos.
ex.zh: 這支手機有個加強版的相機，可以拍夜景。

ex.en: The software offers enhanced security for users.
ex.zh: 這套軟體為使用者提供加強的安全性。

ex.en: An enhanced version of the game will be released soon.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲的強化版很快就會推出。

ex.en: Their enduring friendship lasted for over fifty years.
ex.zh: 他們持久的友誼維持了五十多年。

ex.en: This song has an enduring appeal for young people.
ex.zh: 這首歌對年輕人有歷久不衰的吸引力。

ex.en: Climbing the mountain was a difficult endeavour for the whole team.
ex.zh: 攀登那座山對整個隊伍來說是一項艱難的嘗試。

ex.en: We wish you well in all your future endeavours.
ex.zh: 祝你未來各項努力都順利。

ex.en: We endeavour to answer every question within a day.
ex.zh: 我們盡力在一天之內回答每個問題。

ex.en: She endeavoured to stay calm during the interview.
ex.zh: 她在面試時努力保持冷靜。

ex.en: Driving too fast can endanger other people on the road.
ex.zh: 開太快可能危及路上的其他人。

ex.en: Pollution may endanger the fish living in this river.
ex.zh: 污染可能危及生活在這條河裡的魚。

ex.en: I entrusted my keys to my neighbor while I was away.
ex.zh: 我出遠門時把鑰匙託給了鄰居。

ex.en: The teacher entrusted him with an important task.
ex.zh: 老師把一項重要的任務託付給他。

ex.en: I want to enrol in an evening English class this fall.
ex.zh: 我想在今年秋天報名一個英文夜間班。

ex.en: You must enrol before the end of the month to get the discount.
ex.zh: 你必須在月底前登記才能享有折扣。

ex.en: Parents can enrol their children online.
ex.zh: 家長可以在線上為孩子辦理註冊。

ex.en: The street entertainer made the children laugh with his tricks.
ex.zh: 街頭藝人用他的把戲逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

ex.en: She dreamed of becoming a famous entertainer.
ex.zh: 她夢想成為一位知名的藝人。

ex.en: The hotel hired an entertainer for the holiday party.
ex.zh: 飯店為假日派對請了一位表演者。

ex.en: A rich businessman endowed the university with a large fund.
ex.zh: 一位富商捐了一大筆基金給這所大學。

ex.en: She endowed a scholarship for poor students.
ex.zh: 她捐設了一份給貧困學生的獎學金。

ex.en: Nature endowed her with a beautiful voice.
ex.zh: 大自然賦予她一副美妙的嗓音。

ex.en: He was endowed with great patience.
ex.zh: 他天生就有很大的耐心。

ex.en: In the ensuing chaos, nobody noticed the thief.
ex.zh: 在隨後的混亂中，沒有人注意到小偷。

ex.en: He moved abroad and, in the ensuing years, rarely visited home.
ex.zh: 他搬到國外，隨後的幾年很少回家。

ex.en: The team lost the match and the ensuing argument lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 球隊輸了比賽，隨之而來的爭論持續了好幾個小時。

ex.en: The children argued endlessly about which game to play.
ex.zh: 孩子們為了要玩哪個遊戲爭論個不停。

ex.en: The road seemed to stretch endlessly across the desert.
ex.zh: 這條路似乎在沙漠中無盡地延伸。

ex.en: The school has an enlightened approach to teaching.
ex.zh: 這所學校的教學方式很開明。

ex.en: He is an enlightened leader who listens to everyone.
ex.zh: 他是個開明的領導者，願意傾聽每個人的意見。

ex.en: The monk was said to have become enlightened after years of meditation.
ex.zh: 據說那位僧人在多年冥想後得到了開悟。

ex.en: She felt enlightened after reading the old philosophy book.
ex.zh: 讀了那本古老的哲學書後，她覺得豁然開朗。

ex.en: The monk spent years seeking enlightenment.
ex.zh: 那位僧人花了多年尋求開悟。

ex.en: The lecture brought some enlightenment to the audience.
ex.zh: 這場演講讓聽眾有所啟發。

ex.en: The Enlightenment was an intellectual movement in Europe in the eighteenth century.
ex.zh: 啟蒙運動是十八世紀歐洲的一場思想運動。

ex.en: Many writers of the Enlightenment argued for reason and science.
ex.zh: 許多啟蒙運動的作家主張理性與科學。

ex.en: Lesotho is an enclave completely surrounded by South Africa.
ex.zh: 賴索托是被南非完全包圍的一塊飛地。

ex.en: The city has a small enclave where many artists live and work.
ex.zh: 這座城市有一小塊藝術家聚居與工作的區域。

ex.en: A short walk can energize you in the middle of the day.
ex.zh: 白天散個短步能讓你精神一振。

ex.en: The coach's speech energized the whole team.
ex.zh: 教練的演說激勵了全隊。

ex.en: Good teachers engender a love of learning in students.
ex.zh: 好老師能在學生心中培養出對學習的熱愛。

ex.en: The new rule engendered a lot of anger among workers.
ex.zh: 這項新規定在員工之間引發了許多怒氣。

ex.en: The doctor performed an endoscopic examination of his stomach.
ex.zh: 醫生為他的胃做了內視鏡檢查。

ex.en: Endoscopic surgery needs only tiny cuts in the skin.
ex.zh: 內視鏡手術只需在皮膚上開很小的切口。

ex.en: Huge waves engulfed the small boat.
ex.zh: 巨浪吞沒了那艘小船。

ex.en: Flames quickly engulfed the old wooden house.
ex.zh: 火焰迅速吞噬了那棟舊木屋。

enlarged.zh: 放大；擴大（enlarge 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: She enlarged the photo and put it on the wall.
ex.zh: 她把照片放大後掛到牆上。

ex.en: The school enlarged its library last year.
ex.zh: 學校去年擴建了圖書館。

ex.en: The doctor found an enlarged lymph node in his neck.
ex.zh: 醫生發現他頸部有一顆腫大的淋巴結。

ex.en: I bought an enlarged print of the family picture.
ex.zh: 我買了一張放大的全家福照片。

ex.en: The president sent a special envoy to the talks.
ex.zh: 總統派了一位特使參加會談。

ex.en: The envoy delivered a message from his government.
ex.zh: 那位使節傳達了他政府的訊息。

ex.en: The museum offers enrichment programs for school children.
ex.zh: 這間博物館為學童提供充實學習的課程。

ex.en: Travel can be a great source of personal enrichment.
ex.zh: 旅行是個人成長與充實心靈的絕佳來源。

ex.en: The enrichment of the soil with compost helped the vegetables grow.
ex.zh: 用堆肥改良土壤，讓蔬菜長得更好。

ex.en: Farmers use natural enrichment to keep their fields productive.
ex.zh: 農夫用天然的方式增加土壤肥力，讓田地保持產量。

enshrine.zh: （以法律等）正式確立、使神聖不可侵犯

ex.en: The right to free speech is enshrined in the constitution.
ex.zh: 言論自由的權利被明文載入憲法。

ex.en: The law enshrines equal pay for equal work.
ex.zh: 這項法律明文保障同工同酬。

ex.en: She gave an engaging talk that kept everyone listening.
ex.zh: 她的演講引人入勝，讓大家都專心聽。

ex.en: The teacher has an engaging way of explaining things.
ex.zh: 這位老師解釋事情的方式很吸引人。

ex.en: The old pot was covered with white enamel.
ex.zh: 那只舊鍋外面塗著白色的琺瑯。

ex.en: Sugary drinks can damage the enamel on your teeth.
ex.zh: 含糖飲料可能損傷牙齒的琺瑯質。

ex.en: The artist enameled the metal box with bright blue.
ex.zh: 藝術家在這個金屬盒上塗了亮藍色的琺瑯。

ex.en: They enameled the bathtub to make it shine.
ex.zh: 他們給浴缸上了瓷釉，讓它閃閃發亮。

ex.en: A low stone wall encircles the old garden.
ex.zh: 一道矮石牆環繞著這座老花園。

ex.en: Fans encircled the singer as she left the building.
ex.zh: 歌手離開大樓時，歌迷把她團團圍住。

ex.en: Thick fog began to envelop the whole valley.
ex.zh: 濃霧開始籠罩整個山谷。

ex.en: She enveloped the baby in a soft blanket.
ex.zh: 她用柔軟的毯子把寶寶包起來。

ex.en: Enrolment for the summer course starts next Monday.
ex.zh: 暑期課程的註冊下週一開始。

ex.en: The school's enrolment has grown by ten percent this year.
ex.zh: 這所學校今年的入學人數增加了百分之十。

ex.en: The rule is strictly enforced on weekdays.
ex.zh: 這項規定在平日被嚴格執行。

ex.en: After his injury, he had a long period of enforced rest.
ex.zh: 受傷後，他被迫休息了很長一段時間。

ex.en: The enterprising student started a small business in college.
ex.zh: 這位有魄力的學生在大學時就開了一間小公司。

ex.en: It was an enterprising idea to sell lemonade near the stadium.
ex.zh: 在球場附近賣檸檬汁是個很有創業精神的點子。

ex.en: The singer arrived with a large entourage.
ex.zh: 那位歌手帶著一大群隨行人員抵達。

ex.en: The minister's entourage waited outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 部長的隨行人員在飯店外等候。

ex.en: The slogan encapsulates the spirit of the brand.
ex.zh: 這句口號概括了品牌的精神。

ex.en: The medicine is encapsulated to protect the stomach.
ex.zh: 這種藥被做成膠囊以保護胃部。

ex.en: The painting is famous for its enigmatic smile.
ex.zh: 這幅畫以其謎一般的微笑聞名。

ex.en: He gave an enigmatic answer and walked away.
ex.zh: 他給了一個令人費解的回答就走開了。

ex.en: The disease is endemic in some tropical regions.
ex.zh: 這種疾病在某些熱帶地區是地方性流行的。

ex.en: Many endemic plants grow only on this island.
ex.zh: 許多特有植物只生長在這座島上。

ex.en: They will engrave your name on the ring.
ex.zh: 他們會把你的名字刻在戒指上。

ex.en: The artist engraved a small flower on the glass.
ex.zh: 藝術家在玻璃上刻了一朵小花。

ex.en: The engraving on the ring says her name and the date.
ex.zh: 戒指上的刻字是她的名字和日期。

ex.en: He bought an old engraving of the city at a flea market.
ex.zh: 他在跳蚤市場買了一幅這座城市的老版畫。

ex.en: Engraving metal takes patience and a very steady hand.
ex.zh: 雕刻金屬需要耐心和一雙非常穩的手。

engineered.zh: 經工程設計的；人工改造的

ex.en: The bridge is a well engineered structure that can survive earthquakes.
ex.zh: 這座橋是設計良好的工程結構，能承受地震。

ex.en: Genetically engineered crops are debated in many countries.
ex.zh: 基因改造作物在許多國家引發爭論。

engineered.zh: 設計；策劃（engineer 的過去式）

ex.en: She engineered a plan to save the old library.
ex.zh: 她策劃了一個拯救舊圖書館的方案。

ex.en: The team engineered a faster way to build the engine.
ex.zh: 團隊設計出一種更快的方式來製造引擎。

ex.en: The enactment of the new law took several months.
ex.zh: 這項新法的制定花了好幾個月。

ex.en: Many people supported the enactment of stricter safety rules.
ex.zh: 許多人支持頒布更嚴格的安全規定。

entrenched.zh: 根深蒂固的；牢固確立的

ex.en: Old habits can be deeply entrenched and hard to change.
ex.zh: 舊習慣可能根深蒂固，很難改變。

ex.en: The company has an entrenched position in the local market.
ex.zh: 這家公司在當地市場的地位十分穩固。

ex.en: I read the book in its entirety over the weekend.
ex.zh: 我整個週末把這本書從頭到尾讀完了。

ex.en: The road will be closed in its entirety during the repairs.
ex.zh: 整段道路在修繕期間都會封閉。

ex.en: His rude comment enraged the whole audience.
ex.zh: 他無禮的言論激怒了全體觀眾。

ex.en: Nothing enrages her more than being ignored.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比被忽視更讓她氣憤。

ex.en: Long years of habit entrenched the old way of working.
ex.zh: 多年的習慣讓舊的工作方式根深蒂固。

ex.en: The company tried to entrench its position in the market.
ex.zh: 公司試圖鞏固它在市場上的地位。

ex.en: The statue was encased in glass to protect it.
ex.zh: 那座雕像被裝在玻璃罩中加以保護。

ex.en: Workers encased the pipes in concrete.
ex.zh: 工人們把管線用混凝土包起來。

ex.en: Entropy measures how disordered a system is.
ex.zh: 熵是用來衡量一個系統混亂程度的量。

ex.en: In a closed system, entropy tends to increase over time.
ex.zh: 在封閉系統中，熵往往會隨時間增加。

ex.en: Don't let work encroach on your family time.
ex.zh: 別讓工作侵占你的家庭時間。

ex.en: The city keeps encroaching on the farmland around it.
ex.zh: 城市不斷蠶食周圍的農地。

ex.en: She enthused about her trip to Japan for an hour.
ex.zh: 她熱情洋溢地談了一個小時她的日本之旅。

ex.en: Fans enthused over the new album online.
ex.zh: 粉絲們在網路上對新專輯讚不絕口。

ex.en: The clerk gave the enquirer a list of opening times.
ex.zh: 店員給了詢問者一份營業時間表。

ex.en: An enquirer called to ask about the price of the tickets.
ex.zh: 有位詢問者打電話來問票價。

ex.en: A few jokes helped enliven the boring meeting.
ex.zh: 幾個笑話讓無聊的會議活潑了起來。

ex.en: Bright flowers can enliven a plain room.
ex.zh: 鮮豔的花可以讓單調的房間生色。

ex.en: The university offers a course on entrepreneurship.
ex.zh: 這所大學開設創業課程。

ex.en: Entrepreneurship requires courage and a lot of hard work.
ex.zh: 創業需要勇氣與大量的努力。

ex.en: Be careful not to entangle the fishing lines.
ex.zh: 小心不要讓釣魚線纏在一起。

ex.en: I don't want to entangle myself in their argument.
ex.zh: 我不想讓自己捲入他們的爭執。

ex.en: The old man remained an enigma to his neighbors.
ex.zh: 那位老人對鄰居來說始終是個謎。

ex.en: The cause of the accident is still an enigma.
ex.zh: 這場意外的原因仍然是個謎。

ex.en: The teacher asked us to enunciate each word clearly.
ex.zh: 老師要我們把每個字發音發清楚。

ex.en: He enunciated slowly so everyone could understand.
ex.zh: 他慢慢地吐字，好讓大家都聽得懂。

ex.en: She enunciated the goals of the project.
ex.zh: 她明確地說明了專案的目標。

ex.en: The president enunciated a new policy.
ex.zh: 總統明確地宣布了一項新政策。

ex.en: Invaders enslaved many people in the conquered land.
ex.zh: 入侵者奴役了被征服土地上的許多人。

ex.en: Don't let your phone enslave you.
ex.zh: 別讓手機把你變成它的奴隸。

ex.en: Farmers protested the encroachment of houses onto their fields.
ex.zh: 農民抗議房屋侵佔他們的農地。

ex.en: He felt the constant calls were an encroachment on his private time.
ex.zh: 他覺得不斷的來電是對他私人時間的侵犯。

ex.en: He looked up the history of Rome in an old encyclopaedia.
ex.zh: 他在一本舊百科全書裡查羅馬的歷史。

ex.en: The library has a children's encyclopaedia with many colorful pictures.
ex.zh: 圖書館有一套兒童百科全書，裡面有很多彩色圖片。

ex.en: The village looked enchanting under the soft snow.
ex.zh: 村莊在輕柔的雪下顯得迷人。

ex.en: She gave an enchanting performance that delighted the audience.
ex.zh: 她迷人的演出讓觀眾非常開心。

ex.en: The children found an enchanted forest in the story.
ex.zh: 孩子們在故事裡發現了一座施了魔法的森林。

ex.en: She told us about an enchanted castle hidden in the clouds.
ex.zh: 她對我們講述一座藏在雲間的魔法城堡。

ex.en: The beautiful music enchanted everyone in the hall.
ex.zh: 優美的音樂讓禮堂裡的每個人都為之陶醉。

ex.en: The little girl was enchanted by the snow.
ex.zh: 小女孩被雪迷住了。

ex.en: She has an enviable talent for languages.
ex.zh: 她擁有令人羨慕的語言天分。

ex.en: They live in an enviable position near the sea.
ex.zh: 他們住在令人稱羨的海邊位置。

ex.en: This bread is made with enriched flour.
ex.zh: 這種麵包是用強化營養的麵粉製成的。

ex.en: Many breakfast cereals are enriched with vitamins.
ex.zh: 許多早餐穀片添加了維生素。

ex.en: Can you enumerate the reasons for your decision?
ex.zh: 你能列舉你做這個決定的原因嗎？

ex.en: The teacher asked us to enumerate the main causes of the war.
ex.zh: 老師要我們列出這場戰爭的主要原因。

ex.en: The entomologist spent years studying butterflies.
ex.zh: 這位昆蟲學家花了好幾年研究蝴蝶。

ex.en: An entomologist can tell insects apart by tiny details.
ex.zh: 昆蟲學家能從細微之處分辨不同的昆蟲。

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread was enticing.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味十分誘人。

ex.en: The hotel offered an enticing discount for early bookings.
ex.zh: 飯店為提早訂房的客人提供誘人的折扣。

ex.en: The novel can engross readers for hours.
ex.zh: 這本小說可以讓讀者入迷好幾個小時。

ex.en: Complex puzzles engross him completely.
ex.zh: 複雜的謎題讓他完全沉浸其中。

ex.en: The entanglement of the fishing lines took an hour to fix.
ex.zh: 那些釣魚線纏在一起，花了一個小時才解開。

ex.en: Divers must avoid any entanglement in old nets.
ex.zh: 潛水員必須避免被舊漁網纏住。

ex.en: He wanted to avoid any political entanglement abroad.
ex.zh: 他想避免在國外捲入任何政治糾葛。

ex.en: Their emotional entanglement made the decision harder.
ex.zh: 他們之間的感情糾葛讓這個決定更加困難。

ex.en: She did not understand the enormity of the task at first.
ex.zh: 她起初並不了解這項任務有多麼艱鉅。

ex.en: The enormity of the problem scared everyone.
ex.zh: 問題的嚴重程度讓每個人都害怕。

ex.en: The court was shocked by the enormity of his crime.
ex.zh: 法庭對他罪行的惡劣程度感到震驚。

ex.en: History remembers the enormity of that terrible act.
ex.zh: 歷史記得那件可怕行為的惡劣。

ex.en: The soldiers set up an encampment beside the river.
ex.zh: 士兵們在河邊紮起了營地。

ex.en: From the hill we could see the large encampment below.
ex.zh: 我們從山上能看到下方那片大營地。

ex.en: Environmentalism has grown as people worry about climate change.
ex.zh: 隨著人們擔憂氣候變遷，環境保護主義日益興起。

ex.en: Her interest in environmentalism began at a school tree-planting event.
ex.zh: 她對環保主義的興趣，是從學校的植樹活動開始的。

ex.en: The baby's toothless smile is very endearing.
ex.zh: 寶寶沒牙的笑容非常討人喜愛。

ex.en: He has an endearing habit of singing while cooking.
ex.zh: 他有個可愛的習慣，就是邊煮飯邊唱歌。

ex.en: The magician's tricks enthrall children of all ages.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲讓各年齡的孩子都著迷。

ex.en: The story is sure to enthrall you from the first page.
ex.zh: 這個故事保證會讓你從第一頁就入迷。

ex.en: She left her wet shoes in the entryway.
ex.zh: 她把濕鞋子放在玄關。

ex.en: A small table with a lamp stood in the entryway of the house.
ex.zh: 房子的入口處放著一張附燈的小桌子。

ex.en: The audience clapped for a long time and asked for an encore.
ex.zh: 觀眾拍了很久的手，要求安可。

ex.en: The band played two songs as an encore.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了兩首歌作為安可曲。

ex.en: "Encore! Encore!" shouted the crowd.
ex.zh: 「安可！安可！」群眾大喊著。

ex.en: After the last song, people cried "Encore!" again and again.
ex.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，大家一再高喊「安可！」。

ex.en: In the fairy tale, the castle was under an enchantment.
ex.zh: 在童話故事裡，那座城堡被施了魔法。

ex.en: The village has an old-world enchantment that charms visitors.
ex.zh: 這座村莊有一種古老的魅力，吸引著遊客。

ex.en: The city and its environs are home to a million people.
ex.zh: 這座城市及其周邊地區住著一百萬人。

ex.en: We spent the weekend exploring the environs of the old castle.
ex.zh: 我們週末在古堡周邊地區四處探索。

ex.en: The enraged customer shouted at the manager.
ex.zh: 憤怒的顧客對經理大吼。

ex.en: She was enraged when she saw the damage to her car.
ex.zh: 她看到車子受損時氣炸了。

ex.en: The unfair ruling enraged the fans.
ex.zh: 這個不公平的裁決激怒了球迷。

ex.en: His rude reply enraged her even more.
ex.zh: 他無禮的回答讓她更加憤怒。

ex.en: The referee acts as the enforcer of the game's rules.
ex.zh: 裁判負責執行比賽規則。

ex.en: The company hired a safety enforcer to check the factory.
ex.zh: 公司聘請了一名安全執行人員檢查工廠。

ex.en: Ivy began to entwine itself around the old fence.
ex.zh: 常春藤開始纏繞在老舊的籬笆上。

ex.en: Their lives became entwined after they moved to the same town.
ex.zh: 他們搬到同一個城鎮後，生活變得交織在一起。

ex.en: There was long-standing enmity between the two families.
ex.zh: 這兩個家族之間存在著長期的敵意。

ex.en: Their enmity faded after years of working together.
ex.zh: 多年共事之後，他們之間的敵意逐漸消散。

ex.en: He felt no enmity toward the people who had criticized him.
ex.zh: 他對批評過他的人毫無敵意。

ex.en: The beautiful old town enamored every visitor.
ex.zh: 這座美麗的古城讓每位遊客都為之傾心。

ex.en: He was enamored of the idea of living by the sea.
ex.zh: 他迷戀著住在海邊的想法。

ex.en: The body makes endogenous hormones on its own.
ex.zh: 身體會自行製造內源性荷爾蒙。

ex.en: Economists studied endogenous factors that drive growth from within a country.
ex.zh: 經濟學家研究了從國家內部推動成長的內生因素。

ensconced.zh: 安頓好的；舒適地坐定的

ex.en: She was ensconced in an armchair with a good book.
ex.zh: 她舒舒服服地窩在扶手椅裡讀著一本好書。

ex.en: The cat ensconced itself on the warm windowsill.
ex.zh: 那隻貓舒服地窩在溫暖的窗台上。

ex.en: His honest smile helped endear him to everyone.
ex.zh: 他誠懇的笑容讓大家都喜歡上他。

ex.en: Her kindness did much to endear her to the neighbors.
ex.zh: 她的善良讓鄰居們非常喜愛她。

ex.en: The children played energetically all afternoon.
ex.zh: 孩子們整個下午精力充沛地玩耍。

ex.en: She energetically defended her idea in the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上積極地為自己的想法辯護。

engraved.zh: 雕刻；刻上（engrave 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: He engraved his daughter's name on the silver ring.
ex.zh: 他在銀戒指上刻了女兒的名字。

ex.en: The dates were engraved into the stone by hand.
ex.zh: 那些日期是用手工刻在石頭上的。

ex.en: The memory of that day is engraved in my mind.
ex.zh: 那一天的記憶深深刻在我的腦海裡。

ex.en: The magician's tricks enthral children every time.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲每次都能迷住孩子們。

ex.en: The story will enthral readers from the first page.
ex.zh: 這個故事從第一頁起就會吸引讀者。

ex.en: His enlistment in the army lasted four years.
ex.zh: 他在軍中的服役期是四年。

ex.en: Enlistment rates dropped last year.
ex.zh: 去年的入伍人數下降了。

ex.en: The law enjoins companies to protect customer data.
ex.zh: 法律責成公司要保護客戶資料。

ex.en: The judge enjoined him from contacting the witness.
ex.zh: 法官命令他不得聯絡該名證人。

ex.en: The two endpoints of the line are marked A and B.
ex.zh: 這條線的兩個端點標為 A 和 B。

ex.en: The bus route's endpoint is the train station.
ex.zh: 這條公車路線的終點是火車站。

ex.en: Salt began to encrust the old rope.
ex.zh: 鹽分開始在舊繩子上結成一層硬殼。

ex.en: The crown was encrusted with jewels.
ex.zh: 那頂王冠鑲滿了寶石。

enabling.zh: 使能夠（enable 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The new software is enabling teachers to grade papers faster.
ex.zh: 新軟體讓老師能更快批改作業。

ex.en: Good roads are enabling farmers to reach the market easily.
ex.zh: 良好的道路讓農民能輕鬆到達市場。

ex.en: Fish got enmeshed in the net.
ex.zh: 魚被網纏住了。

ex.en: He was enmeshed in a legal dispute for years.
ex.zh: 他多年來深陷在一場法律糾紛裡。

ex.en: We ordered chicken enchiladas with a spicy red sauce.
ex.zh: 我們點了淋上辣紅醬的雞肉墨西哥捲餅。

ex.en: She rolled the tortillas into enchiladas and baked them.
ex.zh: 她把玉米餅捲成墨西哥捲餅後拿去烤。

ex.en: The teacher smiled encouragingly at the nervous student.
ex.zh: 老師對緊張的學生鼓勵地微笑。

ex.en: Sales have risen encouragingly over the past three months.
ex.zh: 過去三個月銷售額令人振奮地成長。

ex.en: His lawyer argued that the arrest was entrapment by the police.
ex.zh: 他的律師主張這次逮捕是警方的誘捕。

ex.en: Entrapment happens when officers push someone into committing a crime.
ex.zh: 警察逼人犯罪時，就構成了誘捕。

encyclopedic.zh: 百科全書式的；知識淵博的

ex.en: He has an encyclopedic knowledge of old movies.
ex.zh: 他對老電影的知識淵博得像百科全書。

ex.en: The museum offers an encyclopedic collection of world art.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了涵蓋面極廣的世界藝術品。

ex.en: The Pope published an encyclical about caring for the environment.
ex.zh: 教宗發表了一份關於愛護環境的通諭。

ex.en: The priest read part of the encyclical aloud to the congregation.
ex.zh: 神父向會眾朗讀了通諭的一部分。

ex.en: She likes to ensconce herself in an armchair with a good book.
ex.zh: 她喜歡舒舒服服地窩在扶手椅裡看一本好書。

ex.en: The cat ensconced itself on the warm windowsill.
ex.zh: 貓舒服地窩在溫暖的窗台上。

ex.en: Traveling abroad was an enriching experience for her.
ex.zh: 出國旅行對她而言是一段充實心靈的經驗。

ex.en: Reading to children is an enriching habit.
ex.zh: 唸書給孩子聽是個豐富心靈的好習慣。

ex.en: He was enamoured of the quiet fishing village.
ex.zh: 他深深迷上了那個安靜的漁村。

ex.en: She was never enamoured with city life.
ex.zh: 她從來沒有迷戀過都市生活。

ex.en: We got lost and ended up in a different town.
ex.zh: 我們迷路了，最後來到另一個小鎮。

ex.en: If you keep spending like this, you'll end up with no savings.
ex.zh: 你再這樣花錢，到頭來會一毛積蓄都沒有。

ex.en: He ended up becoming a teacher, just like his mother.
ex.zh: 他最後成了老師，就和他母親一樣。

end up.en: to be in a situation or place after a series of events, often not planned
